title: Amazon sues Perplexity over Comet's shopping agent buying on its site
summary: Amazon sued Perplexity in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging that Perplexity's Comet agent disguises itself as a Chrome browser, refuses to identify itself in the Amazon Store, makes purchases for users without authorization, misappropriates Prime membership benefits and violates computer fraud and abuse statutes; Amazon seeks compensatory damages and injunctive relief after sending a cease-and-desist letter the previous week. Perplexity called the suit a threat to user choice, argued that users have the right to an assistant acting on their behalf, and said the Amazon login credentials Comet uses are stored securely.
